question: At equal experience and rollout length, does the yaw-gated stride setup of PR 71 pass more learning probes than plain reward v4?

source.note: PR 71 head holds main through PR 70 and the options --steps-per-env and --reward-task. One source freeze serves the four attempts.

budget.approval: docs/TRAINING.md reserves a rollout above 24 controls for the program lead. The program lead approved 48 controls and 2500 updates for this packet on 2026-10-12.

arms.yawgate: The reward task, reward options and learner options of ppo_v4_stride_c48_u2500_seed20260917_20261011_001 in site/assets/yaw_gated_stride_native_20261012_001/native_results.json (PR 71), unchanged.
arms.plain: Reward v4 with forward_draw_fraction=0, joint_margin_weight=1.0 and yaw_tracking_weight=0.5, the weights of arm B in site/assets/reward_v4_controlled_comparison_20261007_001; the same learner options and budget as the yawgate arm.

evaluation: After each training launch: the 13 learning probes at update 2500 from the frozen training source, --eval-scope probes, actor mean without sampling noise, one deterministic trial per probe.
measure: Learning-probe passes of 13 at update 2500, per attempt.

verdicts.replication: Supported if the yawgate arm passes 13 of 13 at both seeds. Unsupported if it passes fewer than 13 at both seeds. Mixed otherwise.
verdicts.extra_terms: Supported if the plain arm passes fewer probes than the yawgate arm at both seeds. Unsupported if the plain arm passes at least as many probes as the yawgate arm at both seeds. Mixed otherwise.

limits: The 13 probes hold no arc command, no 0.025 m/s walk and one transition, so a pass does not establish omnidirectional motion. A full-scope evaluation of a checkpoint covers those cases; this packet does not run it.
The yawgate arm differs from the plain arm in turn-heavy sampling, the yaw gate, stride tracking, stride length and the termination weight. The packet tests them as one set.
The seed 20260917 run that PR 71 records came from source 1b4d67a1, before PR 65 changed env.py. It stays a separate record.
Learning probes are diagnostics. Stage 2 remains incomplete.
failure_rule: A failed or timed-out launch stays on record under its name. The queue continues with the next attempt and retries none.
